notes.title: LATE ACCESS!
notes.content:
From August 25th until August 31st, purchase the Half Minute Hero Bundle at 33% off and receive:
[list]
[*]A free copy of the first game: Half-Minute Hero: Super Mega Neo Climax Ultimate Boy!
[*]The complete soundtrack for Half-Minute Hero: The Second Coming!
[*]A loyalty discount of 50% on Skullgirls until September 7th!
[/list]

Don't worry! All existing owners will receive the above at no charge! 
[b]However, you will not receive extra copy of HMH:SMNCUB if you already have it in your Steam library[/b]

http://store.steampowered.com/app/240970/

notes.title: Announcing "Goddess' Map of the Week" contest!
notes.content:
Every week, we're going to highlight a user made map that catches our fancy and has been made popular by the community. The winner will receive a Half Minute Hero digital watch!  Start building, playing, and voting for all of your awesome maps!

UPDATED Rules:
[list]
[*]You can only win once.
[*]The winner will be selected by The Time Goddess from ALL new maps that are submitted every week starting Wednesday at 0:00 UST  and ending the following Wenesday at the same time. 
[*]For the period of April  23rd- April 30th ONLY, all existing maps will qualify for entry. 
[*]Winners will be friended on Steam to exchange mailing information.
[*]Good luck!
[/list]

[H1]This week's winner is "Multi", who has not one, but TWO MAPS in the top 5! (Remember from next week, it will be all NEW maps! [/H1]

http://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=249717105&searchtext=

http://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=245776157&searchtext=


Last week's winner: Boo

http://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=248241978&searchtext=

notes.title: UPDATE on LP/Livestreams/YouTube
notes.content: Hello, everyone! There seems to be a misunderstanding about our policy on showing the game on your channel. You don't need to register to do it. You have our permission to monetize the content, AND you always have. We just stopped giving out free codes for the time being.
